annotations.title: Share or hide the public progress report

description: When public is true, returns a public progress-report URL that includes display name, goals, KPIs, and verdicts, and excludes email, notes, and keys. When public is false, hides the public report. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: share_report
title: Share or hide the public progress report
